title: One managed source review: the work board, its decision and commands, the reviewer and the Paperclip adapter
why: WBC-02 connects the Tasks board WBC-01 made ready to one real source review, admitted by a person, scheduled by Paperclip and executed by the existing dsh bridge. The packet's sophia.work.board.v1 and sophia.work.receipt.v1 schemas become components here field for field (the plan as sophia.work.plan.v2), so the Studio can drop its feature-local reader for the generated one.

Members propose one fixed source-review plan (POST .../plans/source-review), answer its decision once (POST .../decisions/{id}/answer), command the assignment (POST .../assignments/{id}/commands: Hold, Resume, Stop; guidance unavailable), follow their own operation (GET .../work/operations/{id}) and open the exact result (GET .../work/{id}/result). Receipts carry admission, delivery and effect apart.

The reviewer's runtime operations (/v1/runtime/source-review/*) authenticate like research's: the runtime lease and a binding it owns, fenced by the work's current authority. Its model calls reserve and settle through the shared research accounting (the research reserve and settle shapes), at most eight per review.

The Paperclip adapter asks Sophia for an effect permit per run (/v1/coordination/*), with its own capability bound to one Paperclip company. Sophia attaches a run to a live attempt instead of starting a second, denies held, stopped, finished or withdrawn work before any effect, and reports per-run usage with an unknown cost left null.

value.description: The Paperclip dsh adapter's credential: an opaque secret held by the Paperclip service, stored by Sophia only as SHA-256, bound to one Paperclip company. It is not a member identity and not a Paperclip token.
The registry's priced route the reviewer runs on: what its model calls are reserved and settled at.
The exact answer the Studio sends (WBC-01 CC-0001). operation_id equals the Idempotency-Key.
One shared task command (WBC-01 CC-0001). Only Hold, Resume and Stop are qualified; guidance is refused as unavailable.
A review's exact result while it may be served; otherwise why not. Never a URL.

get.summary: The viewer's work board (sophia.work.board.v1): accepted and proposed plans, live item facts and what the viewer may do. Its snapshot_cursor is the project event cursor.
Whether the caller may propose a source review here now, its bounds, its priced route, and the report versions it may review.

post.summary: Propose one fixed source-review plan for a goal, its criteria and 1-3 eligible sources with a positive allowance. Runs no model and creates no issue: it records the plan and its decision.
